title: Beijing Confirms Historic Xi-Trump-Putin Meeting Is Under Discussion
detail: Beijing has confirmed that a possible trilateral meeting between Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin is under discussion, per a Google News-aggregated headline. No date, venue or agenda was available in the summary; single-source report, unverified.

title: Russia Strikes Kyiv Energy Infrastructure and Northern Bridge Ahead of Abu Dhabi Talks
detail: Russia struck Kyiv energy infrastructure and a bridge in the north of the city ahead of planned talks in Abu Dhabi, per a Google News-aggregated headline. Damage, casualties and munitions used were not available in the summary; single-source report, unverified.
